meaningsEn: the top and bottom of sth
the full vertical extent of sth; from top to bottom
before and after (as in 上下文[shang4 xia4 wen2] "context")

all members of a group (as in 舉國上下|举国上下[ju3 guo2 shang4 xia4] "the entire nation")
relative superiority (as in 不相上下[bu4 xiang1 shang4 xia4] "evenly matched")
